lines.text: (An old-fashioned city with a completely different atmosphere from Elias, which exudes a modern feel, unfolds into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (According to what Ignate told me, it looks like a city that was the capital of a large empire. It’s grand and old-fashioned.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t know why, but the atmosphere feels very chaotic. The expressions on the faces of people passing by on the street look strangely uneasy….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who should I ask?)
(At that time, a young man who looks a bit delinquent passes in front of %s.)
Wow, nice weather. Isn't it? Who am I talking to? Well, it would be perfect to take a nap under the shade!
Sheesh, there's no one who agrees with me, and everyone has a grumpy expression on their faces, so I don't like them at all.
Xiaowei My sister would have smiled and said good things to me... .
Everyone, lighten up your expressions!
Ha, Xiaowei Would the atmosphere in the neighborhood be a little better if you were there? Where on earth have you gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this the person Zoe and Muwen were talking about?)
What are you? Why are you saying my sister's name? Judging by the look on his face, he seems to know something.

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: I am Liu Xingchi. Who are you? say it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Liu Xingchi that someone I know asked me to say hello to Xiaowei. Only then does his face relax.)

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: These are the people you were talking about. Then I will believe you and tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Mr. Xiaowei… ?

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: He is away often, but it seems like the period this time was a bit long. There are a lot of people looking for it, so I'm looking for it too, but I don't know when it will show up... .

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: Then, would you like to look for it together? I've looked around here and there, but I haven't been there yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: There is a place called Red Sorghum Field where a windmill is built. An old man often appears, and some people say they saw him chatting with his sister.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let me go. I'll go and ask.

lines.speaker: 류싱츠
lines.text: Yes. Then I'll ask you a favor.

steps.name: Seeds of Disaster
steps.objective: Defeat [Pumpkin] in “Red Sorghum Field” and obtain <Seed of Disaster>. Then talk to [Zhong Liquan] in the “Red Sorghum Field”.

lines.text: (An old man with a perplexed expression is seen in the middle of a quiet red sorghum field.)
Wow, that's a big deal. This is a big deal. I can't believe I made this mistake... . It's really annoying.
Um, who are you?
(An old man wearing a strange-looking mask looks in this direction as if he felt familiar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, old man?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I ask him if he is the old man who often chatted with Xiaowei.)
That's right. I think I am the old man the young man was talking about. My name is Zhong Liquan. I often chat with my female friend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeo Seon… ?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hey, do you have a moment?  I need you to help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Actually, that's it. As I was passing through this land on my cloud, I suddenly became aware of an evil energy gathering from the mountains and rivers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Passing by on a cloud?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Is this your first time seeing a god riding on clouds?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, that… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Well, there's no need to know that much.
(A mysterious cloud quietly approaches and stops in front of Zhong Liquan.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Do you understand now? Anyway, I was afraid that something big would happen because of my evil energy, so I collected it and put a lot of it in my pocket... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: But… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's wrong.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: The story is fast. I want you to help me gather the seeds of disaster. This seed stirred in the bag and burst out of the sky onto the ground... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: If the seeds of disaster sprout, something big will happen. From the beginning, they might swallow this continent... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: You won't even see the Xiaowei you're looking for.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: … I'm sorry for shamelessly asking you this. Because of my presbyopia, my eyes are a little blurry... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Since I am the lowest of the immortals, there is a lot to do, a lot of stress, and a lot of minor illnesses... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I got it wrong somehow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me help you.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Really?! You are truly a great person. If you have such magical energy, you will be able to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Zhong Liquan grabs %s's hands tightly.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Don’t think that I’m such a shameless good person… . Black and white. anyhow! Find the seeds of disaster nearby.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: The seeds of disaster that have begun to grow are no different from food for monsters, so they are... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hehehehe… . I'm sorry. If you retrieve it properly, I will tell you where my Xiaowei went.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come find you then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That old man seems to be smiling slightly behind his mask... Is it because of his mood?)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Hehe... That kid is quick-witted.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: You guys are amazing.
(Zhong Liquan receives the seeds of disaster and is unable to continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Ah, I lost my mind for a moment. I'm sorry. The child entered Shangri-la. If I go quickly, I might be able to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Sir, it was nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Yeah, be careful. Oops… . I had something to talk about, but you're already gone.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: I was going to say that it would be difficult to find the way unless you are a hermit... .

steps.name: Geomhwa (劍花), Xiaowei
steps.objective:
1. Find [Xiaowei] in “Shangri-La” in “Arcadia”. 
2. Defeat monsters in “Shangri-La” to obtain <Perennial Three> and talk to [Zhong Liquan].

lines.text: (The innermost part of Shangri-la was noisy, so I went in and saw a woman confronting a huge monster.)
(It looks like the monster will trample the woman at any moment. However, the woman is also looking at the monster with formidable force.)
Hyeonmu, one who has fallen into the wrong path. You cannot go beyond me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei?
(The woman turns around in embarrassment at the voice of %s.)
Who is it? How do you know me? No, I set up a barrier so no one can come in, but how can I get here…? . Oh, this isn't important.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Hey, hurry and avoid!!
(Hyeonmu’s eyes changed with Xiaowei’s words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ugh… . This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Obviously, Hyeonmu is still, but it seems like he's approaching in front of me. His body is getting stiffer... It feels like he's being tied up by something...)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Come to your senses!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I’m dizzy… .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: It’s dangerous!!
(The moment a suspicious energy flows out of Hyeonmu at high speed, Xiaowei comes in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Ouch!
(Xiaowei is attacked by Hyeonmu and flies away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Well, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help you too. It's a little uncomfortable to move, but still... .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Please step away. That monster is not something you can deal with!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I think you got hurt because of me... .
Oh my, oh my. Looks like the situation has become awkward.
(A woman's voice is heard from somewhere.)
You naughty turtle! Stay there!!
(When the woman's voice is directed at Hyeonmu, Hyeonmu steps back for a moment as if embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, I feel the strange energy that was binding my entire body disappear and my body becomes lighter.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Ah, Yangso… .
Now! Two people!! Come this way!!

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Here you are, Samae Yangso!
Yes, yes. Yangso Namchaehwa is not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Oh my, Xiao passed out. It's not like you have a pretty face... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Oh, there you are. Looks okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the old man… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: I'm glad to see that you still have the energy to talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Because he saved me.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Yes, yes. Unless you have the energy of a immortal, you won't be able to meet Hyeonmu, but it will also be difficult to escape.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The person the old man called Samae is also a hermit, right?)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: That's exactly what you think. Anyway, it looks like Hyeonmu has no intention of coming here. What do you think?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: My brother has a stern aura, so monsters cannot approach him.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Thank you for saying that. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: The turtle guy seems to have some good judgment. You can see that he feels the death penalty and doesn't chase after it.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Couldn’t you have finished it instead of me?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: There's no way someone as thin as me would enjoy fighting, right?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: That. I see... .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: As expected, the summer affairs will have to be resolved by the hands of the summer people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have no idea because this is a story about gods...)
(As the conversation between the freshmen continues, Xiaowei comes to his senses and wakes up.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Ah, Yangja Jeong. And Yangso… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei, are you awake?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Have you come to your senses? You weren't hurt too much? I'm glad this is all.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Death penalty, is that all you can do to your beloved child? Xiao, let me see your face for a moment.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Oh my, what a scratch on this pretty face. I won't forgive the turtle!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yang So, I’m fine. I'm worried because I don't have enough training.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: I've lost a lot of energy. Don't deal with enemies like that for a while.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I can't protect Yonggyeong like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei, don't blame yourself.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Well, don't be upset about this. Wow, you shouldn't cry. You know the saying, smile, good luck comes when you smile?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Take this monster into my own hands right now!!

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: No matter how precious it is to the younger generation who are on the path to death penalty and prosecution, we must not interfere.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Oh, I'm late to say hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… It is said. Zoe and Muwen came to Yonggyeong to say hello... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Introduce yourself briefly and say that people in Yonggyeong seem to be looking for Xiaowei.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: This has caused concern to many people. Thanks for talking. You don't need to be sorry.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Sozer, you'd better get some rest. I'm sorry we're even suggesting this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Any suggestions?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Xiaowei Sozer comes from a great family. In particular, Sojeo’s qualifications are excellent. Although he is young, his skill with a sword and steady attitude serve as an example to others.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: In addition, his ability to freely manipulate sounds with his beautiful voice, dance moves, and instruments has reached the extreme. I want to make Xiao into a bad guy... .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: That's too much praise.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: But that Hyeonmu guy shows up and gets in the way... . I want to do something, but it's frustrating because I can't do anything about the underworld.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: If you put your hand on it, your superiors will most likely strike you, and something will happen that even the people here will not be able to respond to. It's literally a mess... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: If you don't understand, try reading a book called Eogu Yanyi, which tells the stories of immortals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Ah, Xiaowei. are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: It's okay, %s.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: It's me, Yangja Jeong. These are shameless words from an immoral person... . Please lend me your strength.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Sojeo is asking for this, and we can't pretend not to know, and we're in a situation where we have to be very careful right now... .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Not long ago, while fighting the Dragon Kings, I pulled out Mount Tai and stuck it on the roof of the Dragon Palace... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: It was their fault first, but... . I can't help it. Then, I will offer you a very small amount of help while avoiding the eyes of Queen Mother of the West.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Sister, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: You are lenient on the death penalty. So what kind of help would you like to give?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Here, Samae is the best talent in the eight good fortunes and the best strategist.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Well, that's a good idea, but isn't that too irresponsible?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hehehe, aren’t you the best in the world of immortals?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Anyway, is there Adventurer? It's a good environment. I'm going to help you, so would you mind gathering some supplies?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, me?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Who else is there?  Anyway, I will use the wisdom of heaven to create an elixir that can defeat Hyeonmu. Because it's not difficult. Don't be scared.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: What you need is [Mannyeonsam]. I'm sorry I can't help you this much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'll try it.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. It's surprisingly fast, and it's already gone... .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Thank you… . For my unscrupulous self... .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Xiao should rest well. Even for that child.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: There he comes.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: I was surprised that it arrived sooner than expected. He might… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Samae, shh. For now, we're just helping.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there. It was easier to obtain than I thought.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Okay. It won't be difficult to make the elixir, so please talk to us for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what about Xiaowei?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: You don't have to worry. Because I fell asleep for a moment. What topic should we talk about? Do you like idols?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Idol?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Yes, idol. There's an idol I like these days... .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Finished making the elixir!

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hehe, that's too bad. I could talk endlessly.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Consider yourself lucky that the elixir preparation was completed so quickly. Otherwise, my brother-in-law would have been reciting what he likes about his favorite idol all night long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Now, drink this up. Adventurer, good vibes to you… . Oh, are you suspicious?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: So let me explain briefly. My brother and I, all eight good people, are called the Palseon. This medicine connects the spirit of our Eight Immortals with you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: This may be a difficult thing to say, Samae. To put it simply, you are borrowing a little of our power. The work of the lower world must be done by the people of the lower world, but sometimes it is like this when things are difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a medicine that uses the power of immortals. Is it okay to drink it?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Haha, we die one way or another, but aren't we all the same?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Oops, I'm running out of words. Just drink it all up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gulp)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It doesn't taste good, but I feel like I have gained strength. What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Go and defeat Hyeonmu. Since the power of the Eight Immortals is connected, it won't be that difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Xiaowei got hurt because of me, so I'll fix it.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Trust me, trust us. Then you might gain strength that you never had before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will believe it. Then, let's go to exterminate Hyunmoo.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Have a nice trip. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Samae, what do you think Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: That Adventurer will do just fine. He is a lower world person who lives even after taking the elixir of the eight good fortunes.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: That’s true, but… . Then shall we watch?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Of course. By the way, it's time for Xiao to wake up.
(After Hyeonmu falls, an unknown energy begins to fill the space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I defeated Hyeonmu. I won.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah. I did it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hyeonmu’s treasures that had been invisible until now begin to come into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I have it? Because I defeated Hyeonmu... . I… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I am caught up in an unknown emotion. I definitely didn’t feel like this until just now…)
(Xiaowei appears in the distance and approaches %s with a bright face.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Great! You completely defeated Hyeonmu!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Now all you have to do is destroy the wealth tainted by Hyeonmu's evil energy and purify Shangri-la. It would be perfect to set up a barrier to prevent evil beings like Hyeonmu from approaching... .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Adventurer, thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xiaowei is saying something, but I can’t hear it….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What are you saying?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is all mine!! Are you going to take all of this? I won't let that happen!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Adventurer? no way… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Step back. This is all mine!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: You need to come to your senses! Now %s has been caught up in the remaining evil tricks of Hyeonmu!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go away!! otherwise… .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: (Can I do it now? Should I step down? If I leave it alone, that person will become another Hyeonmu.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: (You can't leave someone who fought against you knowing it was dangerous.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: … That won't work. I will deal with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If you see him approaching with a weapon, he must be coveting the treasure here! I have to take it down...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Xiaowei is smiling. What is it, what is it…?)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: It’s okay… , %s

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I will save you. Please wait a moment.
(Xiaowei was thrown far away by the impact of the attack just now.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you taking my treasure!! Ha!

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm sorry... . I should have saved you... .
(Xiaowei is sitting down and can't get up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This treasure is mine. I won't let anyone else touch it. therefore… .
(When the weapon is raised towards Xiaowei, a strong force from somewhere shakes Hyeonmu-dong. The weapon in %s's hand falls to the floor due to the influence of that energy.)
Stop!!
(Afterwards, a powerful man's voice is heard, and eyes naturally turn towards it.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Are you… .
Xiaowei Miss, please leave this to me. You know. I'm in charge of this.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes… .
you there

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?
(The suspicious man mutters towards us in a low voice.)
Yes, you! Look carefully at who you are trying to harm!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, trying to take my treasure... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My mind is complicated... That man is just in front of me, but I feel an unknown force.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like something is burning in the dark. It's penetrating me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My, why did I… .
(When %s comes to his senses, a young man dressed in a suit is standing there. The young man looks at %s's condition and supports Xiaowei.)
I came to my senses. It will take quite a while to come back from Hyeonmu, but I guess my mental strength is quite strong... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did I do that... . Ah, Xiaowei! Xiaowei! are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm fine. More than that, thank you for stopping him, Kazno.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes, Xiao. how have you been doing?

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Yes, yes... . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Kazno… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a name I’ve heard somewhere… I’m sure it’s somewhere… Where…?)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Xiaowei Miss, wouldn't it be hard to play if you got hurt like this?
(A man called Kazno places his hand on Xiaowei's wound. As the wound gradually disappears with some force, Xiaowei's expression also becomes relaxed.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Thank you. It's a power I've felt before, but it's still amazing to see it now.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Xiao! Xiao! are you okay?
(Nam Chae-hwa and Zhong Li-quan approach at a slow pace.)

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: I'm fine. Yangja Jeong and So Yang.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: This friend's energy was fading so I ran to him, but fortunately it seems to have ended well. Oh, you… .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Kazno Nas?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's surprising that a good person knows me. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: It must be harder to meet a famous person like you if you don't know them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that person named Kazno over there famous?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (...I need to talk to you in moderation. Please, Samae.)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (I will.)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: He is a master who conquered the fighting arena of Elias, and saved the Elias royal family from crisis... .

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: A playboy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're a flirt!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Phew, what a flirt. No matter how popular I am, it doesn't mean I'm perceived that way.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Just what I saw... . Oh, no.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well, that's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Mr. Kazno. There's something I'd like to ask... .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Ah, the time has come. Xiaowei Miss, how are you? Hello to everyone else, good luck.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: And you too.
(Kazno just said what he had to say and disappeared.)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (Samai, I think he noticed?)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Was it possible to subdue it here? I doubt it would have been possible, though….)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: (I don't know if Ray-Ray showed up.)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Ray isn't really interested in anything that doesn't concern him. Still... ah, shall we stop here? I think he'll get caught out soon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you two standing there so silently?

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Hehehe, nope.
(Zhong Li-kwon and Nam Chae-hwa look at each other and smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is strange...)

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: (Maybe this person….)

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: Now, shall we go back? Samae, I will bring you Xiaowei sheep, so I will ask you to place a barrier in Shangri-La.

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: Of course. Please take care of Xiao. How do I hit a barrier so that rumors spread that I hit it well? Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: %s, you can go home now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think something happened that I don't know about...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Xiaowei.

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Thank you for today. I received great grace. If you come to Yonggyeong, please be sure to visit me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I made a big mistake and Xiaowei... .

lines.speaker: 샤오위
lines.text: Don't worry too much about that. Then we will go.

lines.speaker: 종리권
lines.text: The clouds that just arrived are quite strong, so we should be able to reach Yonggyeong without any problems. Oh, you should go to Aoichi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aoichi… ?

lines.speaker: 남채화
lines.text: It's a fun place too. See you all later then. Please, there should be no problem.
(As soon as the greetings are over, the good people ascend to the sky on clouds. After a while, the clouds disappear in the direction that appears to be their respective destinations.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wonder if something special is happening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go to Aoichi?

steps.name: princess black moon
steps.objective: Talk to [Ame] in “Aoichi” and find [Princess Black Moon] in “Sixteen Days of the Moon” inside “Black Moon Castle”.

lines.text: (There are many buildings as splendid, antique, and wonderful as Yonggyeong.)
(On the other hand, the atmosphere on the street seems to be calm and quiet... when you feel that...)
(A loud noise is heard from behind.)
Get out of the way, out of the way, out of the way!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let’s step aside and observe the situation.)
Stand there! Ame! Don't run away!
(A woman named Ame is being chased by someone and looks around for a while to see if there is a place to hide.)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Sheesh, I can't help it. I can't get caught by Tamori like this... .
(Ame looks at the river flowing on one side of the road and throws herself in an instant.)
(Ame's face emerges from the water. She deftly wades through the water and heads somewhere as if nothing had happened.)
Whoa, you missed that guy. If this happens, it's a big problem... .
(After a while, a man comes out of the crowd and looks at the river with a worried expression. From what people are talking about, I think he is a man called 'Tamori'.)

lines.speaker: 타모리
lines.text: If you keep breaking into the castle and get caught by other shikigami, it will be difficult for everyone... . This guy is like this every time. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something seems to be going on.
Tamori, you went, right? You went, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were in the water earlier... .

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: That's right. that's right. It was like that earlier. Phew, I didn't want to get my favorite clothes dirty and go into the water, but I had no choice.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Hey, listen to my story.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: I and the princess who lives in Black Moon Castle over there, Princess Black Moon, are friends. The atmosphere at Black Moon Castle felt strange these days, so I went to ask how you were doing?

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: But why not kick them out!! I'm so angry. So I try to sneak in to find out somehow, but it doesn't work out. I got caught and am constantly being chased.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's amazing.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Especially that warrior named Tamori, he is not ordinary. I did more than regular ninjas, not less. Still, still! I won't lose next time! I will definitely sneak in.
(Ame is burning with fighting spirit and pledging to take on another challenge.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw a person named Tamori earlier... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tamori talks to Ame about what she said to herself.)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Oh, really? What is it?

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Hey, looking at your outfit, it looks like Adventurer, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Other Adventurer take requests and such, do you too? I'm making an official request, so please help me!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How….)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Huh? huh?
(Ame slowly looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: No big deal! Enter the castle and meet Princess Black Moon. See that the princess is doing well and give her this letter!

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: Just tell Ame that she's worried. We'll prepare the repairs properly, so don't worry too much.
(Ame puts the letter in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Since I was asked to do so, I have no choice but to go.)

lines.speaker: 아메
lines.text: To get to Black Moon Castle, just go straight inside. Then please!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.
I can't believe I was pushed around by an intruder like this!
(The girl who attacked me as soon as I met her takes a step back and expresses her dissatisfaction.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, listen to me. You're a princess, right? Princess Black Moon?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: That's right. But, I have no intention of continuing to listen.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What should we do with this intruder? I have no choice but to try it once until it breaks my spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, over there. wait for a sec!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: If you make excuses, I will listen to them in prison.
(Princess Black Moon’s eyes change.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Be prepared!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it? It doesn't seem like the person I was dealing with just a moment ago. What is this scary power...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Are you thinking about something else during the battle?
(Only then the arrow shot by Princess Black Moon comes into view. However, a small fan flying from somewhere drops the arrow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (W-what is it?)
My daughter is nice, but she has an impatient personality.  Cough.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father? It’s dangerous if you come out now! That intruder doesn't seem ordinary!
It's okay, it's okay. princess. Won't you take a good look? That intruder friend doesn't seem hostile.
(A young man with a poor complexion, but still a good impression, looks at the face of %s with Princess Black Moon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if you are the princess’s father… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: That's right. I am the owner of this castle, the head of Heukwol Castle. To others, he may seem like the princess's older brother, but he is her father.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, if you say that again, I won't have the snack I was planning to give you.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I'm sorry, my daughter. My lovely daughter is upset because of those who are targeting the Black Moon Castle, but I can't do that.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. I'm sorry that I'm like this because of my chronic illness.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, I know you’re okay now.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: You have been caught by our beloved princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, father. Don't overdo it. By the way, you there. Why did you come? Talk about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I kept asking you to listen to me… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Come on, relax. Would you mind telling me what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then let me tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Delivery the letter Ame requested to Princess Black Moon.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ah, ame… .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: You too are amazing. They say he's a talented person who came here to deliver a letter. Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'm sorry, I thought you came for another purpose. And thank you for bringing me Ame’s letter. I will contact Ame right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I'm done, I'll go back. Uh, princess?
(Princess Black Moon grabs the hem of %s's clothes. It looks like she has something to say.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmm, hmm. You. Go out and wait. I'll be there soon.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Princess, no way… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is that?)

steps.name: Jewel of Myno
steps.objective:
1. Listen to the explanation about <Jewel of Myno> in front of Black Moon Castle and find [Cardiff] in "Elfa". 
2. See what happens in front of the “pyramid reality”. 
3. Defeat [Sphinx] within “Pyramid Reality” and acquire [Sand Crystal]. Then take the portal and go outside the “pyramid reality” to understand the situation.  
4. Once the situation is complete, return to “Aoichi” and visit [Princess Black Moon]. 
5. Go to [Ramua] in "Elfa".

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Your skills seem to be good, so I'm going to give you a mission. Please accept it without hesitation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, why did I… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: There is no option to refuse. Because I will refuse. If you complete the mission, I will gladly forgive you for the riot you caused within the castle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like a nuisance... I just need to do it quickly.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Now, focus, focus! You just think you have to get it done quickly anyway, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's really easy to understand. Listen carefully. I'll tell you from now on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, yes… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Among the treasures of Black Moon Castle, there is something called ‘Maino’s Jewel’. It has the power to infinitely expand the user's magical power. Such a precious treasure... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Princess, wait… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Father, I know what you’re going to say. Still, please leave it to me.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Okay, I got it.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: The jewel was cracked due to a fight that happened here a few years ago. I thought it would be okay even if it cracked... . The magical power in the jewel disappeared.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Phew… , It was done by traitors from the Owl Castle who targeted my father.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there any way to repair it?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's a bit difficult to get it repaired. Without that jewel, there will be problems summoning Tengu, the guardian deity of our Black Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Summoning a guardian deity as high as a tengu is a burden, even if your father is a great shaman... .

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: I can't believe a daughter respects her father like this. This father was thrilled.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Dear father, please calm down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: In order to summon the tengu and maintain my father's health... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I have to go to Elfa.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: He looks like he doesn't understand something... . There's another gem from Maino in Elfa. It's like the one in Black Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'd like you to borrow it. Cardiff, the leader of the desert people and the great warrior, please meet him and explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the end?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yeah. Actually, I want to go, but I'm anxious about Black Moon Castle and I have to check on my father's condition... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: This is an important mission for Aoichi, so please do your best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back then. And I hope nothing bad happens in the meantime.
(As %s disappears outside the Black Moon Castle, the castle owner looks at the princess.)

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Daughter.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes, father.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: Can I entrust such an important matter to that person? It's not like usual.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Your father felt it too. There's something different about that person... . For some reason, I think I'll do well.

lines.speaker: 흑월성주
lines.text: That's right, but it could have been left to someone like Tamori, that's why.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Whatever it is, you can do it well.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (It wasn't unfamiliar.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (It's similar to the feeling of pretending to be nice to a girl you don't like... It's annoying...)
I was waiting. You are the one sent from Black Moon Castle.
(A man is standing in the place that Princess Black Moon mentioned. He looks like he is standing normally, but the feeling that comes from the man is like a wild beast hiding its claws.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That person is the leader of the twelve desert tribes, Daejeonsa….)

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: My name is Cardiff. I immediately recognized it because it seemed like the impression I had in the letter sent by the owner of Black Moon Castle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I hope the owl that delivers the letter goes well... .
(Cardiff looks up at the sky and looks worried.)

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I'm sorry. You made the customer wait for a long time. So, shall we talk about Myno’s jewels?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wasn't it just a loan?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: It's urgent. Listen to the story slowly. I also want to lend it right away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Then please tell me.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: For a long time, Aoichi and Elfa have had a relationship similar to that of brothers. So it's not difficult to lend Myno's jewels.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: However, the question is whether it still exists.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, wait a minute? Isn't this a real thing?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Unlike Aoichi's situation, which I still use consistently, Elfa's is a bit... .

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: It was a long time ago when Aoichi gifted Maino's jewels, when Elpha and Aoichi were no longer part of the Elias kingdom.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: It's literally a story about a time when I smoked a cigarette.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: When the pyramids were built in the desert, the leaders of the time dedicated numerous treasures to the royal tombs, including the jewels of Myno.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why... in a place called Pyramid? .

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: It is said that they buried it with jewels to wish for the prosperity of their descendants.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That place called the Pyramid is now a historic site, right? Is it dangerous to go in alone?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Even if your skills are good, I doubt you can overcome the ancient curse. Moreover, the barrier installed to prevent the ancient curse from spreading has been destroyed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can there be no way?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I guess the timing isn't bad. %s, would you like to go to the pyramid?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Suddenly?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: [Ban Ki-woo], there is a person I entrusted with pyramid-related tasks. I wish I could look inside with him to find the Myno jewel... .

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I want to help too, but I'm a little busy with work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. I think it would be okay to go to the Pyramids with someone like Cardiff explained. Then I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Yeah, be careful. As an Elfa warrior, I will pray briefly. May your hand holding the weapon always be with firm faith.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I haven't finished praying, but I'm already gone.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: By the way, his outspokenness is similar to that child Ban Ki-woo was talking about... .
(The poorly dressed young man is puzzled when he sees %s.)
What are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .
Who is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's half the news, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I received a mission from Cardiff... .
(Ban Ki-woo nods his head.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: That's right, but what's going on? What do you have to do with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ban Ki-woo briefly about the situation.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Huh? Was there something like that here? That's true, but it's not like you're getting involved with that horrible princess. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Princess Black Moon?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: All you know! How terrible… . Oh, I guess I'll have to say it's cute because I don't know where you're hearing it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like you've been through a lot.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Wow, I'm exhausted just thinking about it. I feel like my energy is draining away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what can I do?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: I have business at the center of the pyramid, the part called ‘reality’. What did you say your name was?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, my name is %s, feel free to call me that.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Okay, %s. You deal with the Guardian Sphinx here while I search for the Jewel of Myno.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Even though there are a lot of treasures in here, it's not easy to find anything with real power.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: That's why I'm here, because I'm the kind of person who does that without a problem.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Find the real thing, remove the trap. It's a very long process, so don't look for me when dealing with Sphinx.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Don't ask like that. Just dividing the work... I think I do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: It looks like you have skills... . Since the person was sent by the Black Moon Princess, there is no need to worry, right?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Then please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Wow, have you already solved that problem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. As I was doing it… .

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: That guy is fast enough to come to mind. Oh, just like you, I found a gem called Minnow or something with great skill.
(Ban Ki-woo takes out a jewel with a strange atmosphere from his pocket.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is it.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Well, don't just stare at me, please praise me too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Hehe, I did really well. While you were looking for what you needed, I also found what I needed.
(Ban Ki-woo takes out a great sword and shows it with a very happy expression.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Haha, this will definitely help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: It's no big deal. By the way, there was an old man. If you're here, I'd like to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Who else is here but us?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .
You still feel good, kid.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Stop coming out, Mr. Daejeonsa.
(Cardiff slowly walks out from the shadows across from him.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: You've already seen it all, right? The work here is finished.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: You were sent by the Black Moon Princess... , the workmanship is amazing. I didn't expect much.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Do you think so too? I think this is the first time I've seen something like this since then.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Kazno It’s a story… .

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Now the Sphinx won't move for a while. Quickly, restore the pyramid's barrier to its original state.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: This is enough for the pyramid. And I hand over ownership of the sword you found to the ‘Sea Dragon King’s Shaman’.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Thank you, uncle.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: It was only natural since I promised as the great warrior of the desert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what is that sword?

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Man, stop it.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: I guess the woman I fell in love with needed that great sword. But that thing happened to be in a pyramid.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Finding that thing in this pyramid would be like finding a coin that fell from the sky... .

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: That guy found it. amazing. It's a natural talent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, that's amazing.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: There is no need to talk about such things.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Since it's your job to save the girl you're in love with, make sure you do it.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Thank you. mister. Then I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Hey %s, where are you going? Are you going to Black Moon Castle?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I received the jewel, I think I should go to the princess.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: If you don't know where to go later, try going to the Poe Mansion. It'll be fun.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: (The kid is very naughty.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I remember, I'll go.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Okay. Don't tell Princess Black Moon that you saw me. Well then, goodbye to you too. Then let's go.
(As soon as Ban Ki-woo finishes speaking, he disappears.)

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Although there was a request from the Black Moon Princess, the pyramid was able to be put in order thanks to it. Thank you for a great job.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: As expected, the princess's eyes were accurate. There's no way I'm sending it to just anyone... . Cluck cluck. The air is so bad here. Let’s go out quickly too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will go to Princess Black Moon.

lines.speaker: 카디프
lines.text: Okay, goodbye. Say hello to the princess.
(In front of Black Moon Castle, in the distance, Princess Black Moon is waiting with an anxious expression.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were you waiting?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Who, who was waiting? I just happened to have to go out at the right time.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: If Choen had been there, I wouldn't have had to wait. joy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: There is such a person. We used to be together with Iris… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It makes me tell this story. You really… .
(Princess Black Moon gets angry as she talks. The name Iris seems to touch something about Princess Black Moon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Now, here's a gem.
(Hands Myno’s jewels to Princess Black Moon.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I guess something happened because it took a little while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Princess Black Moon about going to the pyramids. As requested by Ban Ki-woo, leave out the story about him.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yeah? But I feel like someone is missing from the story. Is this really true?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Cardiff went back to Elfa and I came here.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Okay. And good job. You don't have to worry about jewelry-related matters anymore.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh, thank you. And when you come to Aoichi later, tell me about your trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You. Where are you going now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I'll go to places I've never been before.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: If you don't know where to go, go back to Elfa. Look for the guy named Ramua of the Assin clan. No. it's okay. joy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, princess. See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Because I am a dishonest person...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're from the Asshin tribe... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…should we go to Elfa first?)
(There is a girl on Elfa Street who wears a different style of clothing than the regular residents.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Looks very busy….)

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Protocol reset… Hyperspace network connection... . Why does it stop like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Who are you… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce myself. I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly introduce yourself to Ramua.)

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: There was a brief error on my part and the response was delayed... . I've never had anything like this before. It seems like there is radio interference... .

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Is it because Adventurer came? Anyway, sorry… You cannot travel to Atlantis using the town portal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how can I get there?

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Pass through El Fa Port and head to the sandy beaches of Orca Beach… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. excuse me… . I heard that Ramua is an Ass god… .

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Although I am from Midgard, the As gods are my ancestors, and I am not... . Still, I am receiving work from them... .

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: In order to operate a machine that moves space and time... . We need someone with a special talent called ‘access ability’, and that is… .

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Saraswati, I don’t know if this will be helpful… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Saraswati?)

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: More details… . I can’t say anything carelessly… . Business confidentiality… .

lines.speaker: 라무아
lines.text: Ugh… , an error appears and I need to fix it. sorry. Because I’m busy… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Ramua. Thank you. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, does this mean that if you move space and time, you can go back in time to the distant past or future?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's complicated. Hmm... Then I'll take a break... Uh, but why do I feel like I have to go to the mansion Ban Ki-woo mentioned?)

steps.name: gothic room
steps.objective: Meet [Princess Black Moon] at the entrance to “Pou Mansion” and defeat [Pandora] inside the mansion. Then talk to [Princess Black Moon] outside the mansion.

lines.text: (My steps stopped at a place with a gloomy yet strange atmosphere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like the Poe Mansion that Ban Ki-woo was talking about.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you introduce this place as an interesting place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's spooky... .
Uh, %s, what are you doing here?
(Someone recognizes %s from one side of the dark shadow and walks over.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: We meet in strange places.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Be sure to come to Aoichi later. Okay? I'll throw a proper banquet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: By the way, you. I thought I was going to leave Aoichi and go somewhere else, but what's going on here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone told me to go here too if I'm on the way.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: There are people talking about useless things. Why are you here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's a bit of a long story. First of all, I came because there was someone in this ominous mansion that I had to rescue.
Oh, you mean Levy?
(Someone suddenly joins the conversation.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What about you?

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: I am Lunaressa, Pandora's subordinate. You can also call it Bampanella.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Do you know Levy? It doesn't matter who you are, go ahead and talk about Levy!!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Levy often stopped by here when he was young.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Is this your first time hearing such a story? You've never said anything like that before... .

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: You don’t know Levy very well. Levy's soul belongs to Pandora.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What do you mean? Does it make sense for a person's soul to belong to someone else? I don't know if it's a devil or a witch... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Wait? Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Bingo, Pandora is a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is the witch talking about?)

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: What an omnipotent witch! You resurrected Levy’s destroyed soul!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What are you talking about!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: In the battle with the Demon King, Levy's soul returned to Pandora. It was resurrected through [Agashura's Contract].

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Ah, the great master.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Did Levi die from the devil? Didn't they all come back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s a story about the party members that Iris was with….)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Don't be funny. Don't talk nonsense!!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Oh, now that you've been safely resurrected, there's no need to be so angry!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Phew, that's enough. %s, you! help me Help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Are you taking Levy with you?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I will take this house even if it means destroying it. Know that!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Will that happen? ball. main. sir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's going on...?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Because I don’t want to be here even for a minute and a second. let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Please wait, Levy….)
(On one side of the mansion, a young man is looking this way with blank eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that person Levy?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy! You are here after all!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy, are you okay? Levy… sir?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I think someone called me, where is it? I hear a voice somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … A familiar voice... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Is it an illusion? I feel a little dizzy... . Oh, I have to go to Pandora. Dear Pandora… .
(Levi looks around and passes by Princess Black Moon.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy! Levy!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I can't believe it. I'm calling you like this right in front of you, so how can you turn away from me... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Oh no… .
(Princess Black Moon looks at Lunaressa, who is following along, as if she has noticed something, with a cursed expression.)

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Hehe… . This is it.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tell me now!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: That's because of the master's magic. Our great master!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I've never heard of magic like that. No… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Now, Levy's soul is isolated from this world and is in another space.

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: If you leave it like this, you will enjoy an eternal tea time with Pandora, so please don't ruin it by interfering!
(Princess Black Moon’s expression becomes distorted.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yeah? So the story ends when you defeat your master?

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Since the Master has taken Levy's soul, if the Master's power disappears... . Hmm.

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Can the princess deal with Pandora? Pandora is Agashura and a witch who uses advanced magic!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know Agashura, but what is a witch?)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph. I had to meet Pandora at least once anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: What do I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… I'm going to meet Agashura.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: If you're scared, you can go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s not like that, but… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then don't talk nonsense and follow me. Let's defeat Pandora and save Levy!

lines.speaker: 루나레사
lines.text: Hua, I, Lunaressa, Pandora's loyal subordinate, can't help you, but cheer up ♬
(As soon as Lunaressa finishes speaking, she disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: … I really don't like it. %s, %s, what do you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I have no idea what Pandora has done here, so you better follow me. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, princess.
(Pandora loses the battle and looks at Princess Black Moon with resignation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was a much harder battle than I thought.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Why? Do you have something to say, Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Indeed, the Black Moon Clan is very different from before... .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph. Don't underestimate me. Witch Pandora.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Now, witch Pandora. Goodbye to this! Anyway, Agashura... .
(Princess Black Moon aims her bow at Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, I want you to stop!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy?
(Princess Black Moon is so embarrassed by Levy's appearance that she loses her grip. However, Levy swings her sword and blocks the flying arrow.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … Are you two okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A person named Levi... easily blocked an arrow flying at Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy, I-I… . I didn't mean to attack Levy.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm fine. You don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, I have a favor to ask. Please do not harm this person.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Yes? That woman is a witch and Agashura!! You put us in danger a few years ago. Moreover, this time I did something bad to Levy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A lot of things happened in the past...)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: As the princess said, my relationship with Pandora is nothing more or less than a contract. This incident was carried out only by contract. It's not Pandora's fault.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The reason I was able to survive at that time was all thanks to Pandora's magic... . I would like you to please step aside.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Now that you speak, Levy, I will step down. I just wanted to rescue Levy, and I have no interest in the witch's life or death.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you, princess. And thank you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: You, the feeling of Iris and… . Oh, no.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess Black Moon. Let's go now.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levy, are you really okay? Can I go back? I… .
(Princess Black Moon grabs Levy's hand. Then, as if realizing something, she lets go of Levy's hand and turns her back.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hey, I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levi, you don’t know how worried Herne is. Oh, then, let’s talk and come out. I'll be waiting outside.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s also follows. Don't just sit here like a fool.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Then I'll wait outside.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you. princess.
(As everyone leaves, Levy holds out her hand towards Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora, my life definitely belongs to you. But there is work to be done elsewhere than here.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Do whatever you want… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'll see you later, after I return to my royal duties. I hope you recover from your injuries.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If that's your choice... .
(Levi bows to Pandora and leaves the mansion.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levy… , What does the outside world mean to you who lost your ‘desperate feelings’ at the cost of your life?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Being caught up in the will of others, and even engaging in a reckless fight with the devil... . You even lost your life.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi, I want to give you a meaning that the world cannot give. You need to know that I am that kind of person.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you, princess.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's not because I want to hear thank you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: While you're helping me, do one more thing. It's not difficult. I will repay you properly when I come to Black Moon Castle later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me help you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Please go to Elias with Levy. You're probably still anxious... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I have to go. My father is hemorrhaging blood around this time.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Levi, see you later. The girl will go first because of her father.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Princess, would you mind if I went alone?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Haven't you seen it? I'm fine enough to scold the witch. So, please ask %s over there for directions.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Mr. Levy. therefore… Oh, no. I'll go,
(Princess Black Moon runs toward the path in the quiet, dark forest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy, what are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: No. Then go to Elias.

steps.name: to the palace
steps.objective: After talking with Levi in front of the "Elias Royal Palace", go to "Hejong".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, since we have arrived at the palace, I will go now.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Where do we go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm thinking about going to Ves or Atlantis.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Could you please wait a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I would like you to wait a moment until I leave after seeing Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay for a while... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Thank you.
(Not long after Levi entered the palace, a loud noise is heard from inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is it so noisy?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Sorry for keeping you waiting. When I spoke to His Majesty, there was an order to come in with him.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: All subjects, give a warm welcome to Adventurer... He said this and so many people came.
(A lot of people are waiting in the palace behind Levi.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please guide me, Levy.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Please follow me.
(Inside the palace that followed Levy, a man wearing a dragon robe is looking at him with a benevolent look.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty… ?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Your Majesty, here is Adventurer %s.
Oh, are you the one who saved Lord Levy? Lift your head up.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Elias Welcome to the palace. I am King Hejong. And this is my daughter, Herne.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Adventurer! I heard you saved Lord Levy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is something that Princess Black Moon did rather than me.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: The princess sent me a letter via crow, and she was full of praise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Princess Black Moon praised you? For some reason, that’s even scarier….)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Thank you for helping Sir Levy.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Jim appreciates it too. I'll stop by to say thank you, but Jim has a favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I heard that you, like other Adventurer, are looking for Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris….)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: You will be found because your performance and qualities are outstanding. However, we will have to get a little closer.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Finding Iris, as Adventurer who found Elias, I would like you to approach it a little more carefully.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Iris is the kingdom's benefactor, so I hope you find it, but it's not easy. There is a precedent that many people gave up because they could not find it... .

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: The look on your face tells me you won't give up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have Iris… .

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: If we go to Atlantis, maybe we can find out the whereabouts of Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atlantis… .

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: You can only go to the underwater city of Atlantis. It's a tightly closed place. They have rules against interacting with us earthlings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should we do?

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: There is a woman who is closely related to Anastasia, the mayor of Atlantis. She is said to be Gatia Su, the sea dragon king's shaman.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Ask her for help. Then maybe the mayor of Atlantis can help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gatia Su… .

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Master Seonseong, who often comes to Elias, knows about the shaman's whereabouts. The Ambassador is in Beth now.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Then please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: all right. your majesty.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Don't push yourself too hard.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, this is what I was supposed to do, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Levy. I came here to look for Iris, so it's my job. Levy, I hope you are doing well until we meet next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will definitely come with Iris.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Yes, I will wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then I guess I have to go to Beth. I wonder where Ambassador Seonseong is going...)

steps.name: Runaway Sea Dragon King
steps.objective:
1. In “Beth”, listen to the story about the [Sea Dragon King] from [Seonseong]. 
2 Listen to the voice coming from the entrance to the “Cold Heart” in the basement of “Kthuga Ruins.” 
3. Purify the heart of the [Sea Dragon King] with <Durandal>, then meet and talk to [Gatia Su].

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Hey, this is my first time seeing Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Ambassador Seonseong?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: That's right. I am goodness, not divinity, but goodness.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Isn’t it great weather today? The weather in Beth is a bit humid, but this is heaven, no paradise, haha.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Hey, it looks like you have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have been sent by none other than His Majesty, the King of Elias.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Your Majesty? Let's see where it goes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hejong tells Seonseong about finding Gatia Su.)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: If it's Gatia... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: It's not a big deal, so I guess you can think of it as coming to help Ban Ki-woo... .

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: I think my skills are good enough for His Majesty to entrust me with a mission... .

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: (cluttering)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying... .

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Now, take this. It's called Durandal.
(Daesan Seonseong takes out a sword from somewhere and gives it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: It is a holy sword known as the true sword that can separate light and darkness without harming the living.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So why did you bring this up?

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Gatia is now near the Sea Dragon King. But now, the Sea Dragon King's energy is filled with malice, and Gatia is watching the situation.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Ban Ki-woo tried to use this to calm down the Sea Dragon King by taking away his energy, but he failed. Durandal is surprisingly difficult to handle if it is not compatible with the user... .

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Anyway, I came back here, left the sword with me, and headed back there.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: But then you came to me and said you were looking for Gatia. This might not be a coincidence. Maybe this sword wanted to meet you.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Hold that sword and take a deep breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s take a deep breath as Master Seonseong said…. The heavy sword suddenly became light. This….)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: It seems like a good sword for you. I find out about this all at once. haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel a mysterious energy. This is….)

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Come on, come to your senses. Power that is easily gained can easily be lost if one is not conscious of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's okay so far.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Take it with you to the Cthuga Ruins and find a space deep inside called 'Cold Heart'.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Even if Ban Ki-woo is a talented person who helps Iris on adventures, it is impossible to deal with a powerful divine beast alone.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Go and help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back then.

lines.speaker: 선성
lines.text: Well then, good luck.
(As the ruins shake, someone's voice is heard through the cracks.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우의 목소리
lines.text: After all, is it impossible without Durandal?

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Van, step back! I have no choice but to step down now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is it? One is Ban Ki-woo's voice, and the other is... ?

lines.speaker: 반 기우의 목소리
lines.text: I can't back out. I can't leave you behind.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I am a shaman who serves the Sea Dragon King. If something happens to the Sea Dragon King, I will be here... .

lines.speaker: 반 기우의 목소리
lines.text: Don’t say things like that, Gatia!!

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Ban, be careful!!
(The roar of a huge, angry creature shakes the ruins. It is so intimidating that living beings collapse in fear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ugh, this power… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s go first. Let’s go and do something….)
(Ban Ki-woo slowly looks around because the sea fog is so thick that it's hard to see ahead.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: … Is it over?
(The Sea Dragon King's eyes close, and his huge body quickly descends, giving the feeling of slowly sinking beneath the water.)
The Sea Dragon King's energy has all been used up. It looks like you're asleep again. Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: It's a relief, but I'm indebted to that guy again. Anyway, thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… .

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Durandal… . I think you use it better than me.
All of the Sea Dragon King's energy has been exhausted... . Ban, who is that person?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Mr. Gatia, that person is the friend I met when I rescued Durandal in the desert. I got help this time too.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Oh, let me formally greet you. Shaman Gatia… It is said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Thank you for your help. AdventurerF. But what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that he is traveling to find Iris, and that he needs Gatia Su's help to get to Atlantis.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I see.
(Gatia Su listens to the story and thinks for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: The shaman still has work left to do. Even though the Sea Dragon King was asleep... . By the way, why didn't Durandal suit me? .

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Are you a little different? (scratch scratch)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know about that either.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I am a member of a clan of shamans who have served the Sea Dragon King since ancient times... . In the past, many people were shamans, but now I am the only one.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: The shaman is in a position to connect humans and the Sea Dragon King, two different beings. Thanks to the Sea Dragon King's power, I may have lived longer than you can see.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Thanks to Durandal, you can stop the rampaging Sea Dragon King, but you never know what might happen. The influence of whatever power you have now... .
(Before Gatia Su's story ends, a blurry figure appears in the water. It is an illusion as if the Sea Dragon King has become smaller.)

lines.speaker: 해룡왕의 영체
lines.text: I'm fine, Gatia Su. And brother, thanks to you I came to my senses!
lines.speakerName: The Spiritual Body of the Sea Dragon King

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Hey, Sea Dragon King, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 해룡왕의 영체
lines.text: Gatia Sue, I'll say it again, I'm fine! I'm so sorry that my body went to sleep to recover and that I was barely able to come out and say thank you.
lines.speakerName: The Spiritual Body of the Sea Dragon King

lines.speaker: 해룡왕의 영체
lines.text: After I rest for a bit, I will call you Gatia... . Ah, it's time. I'm sorry, everyone... .
lines.speakerName: The Spiritual Body of the Sea Dragon King

lines.text: (The Sea Dragon King’s spiritual body gradually becomes blurred.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Sea Dragon King... . Thank goodness… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Hey, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: It seems that the Sea Dragon King appreciates your ‘power’.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Does this mean that the Sea Dragon King is also a spirit creature? Oh, now that I think about it, if you're looking for Iris, the person you went with probably also knows something, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met Zoe, Muwen, Princess Black Moon, and Levy.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: We're here so it's okay. Have you seen Choendo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: At first I thought she was a pretty nice girl, but I had no idea she would do something like that. If you ever see it, don't be fooled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Contrary to his image, he works recklessly, and later... . You betrayed us... . No, I should say that he seemed to be enjoying the situation. anyhow!

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: If he had that level of humanity, he would definitely have been Agashura. What on earth did you want that made you come with us?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t know. What on earth happened….)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I'm sorry for what I said. You said you were going to Atlantis, right?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: The waterway to Atlantis is now open because of the battle.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You might be able to get there by walking all the way down the beach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Hey %s, I know this is a stretch, but could you help me just a little bit?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Gatia… . Is it because of the fire shaman?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes, that's right. There are beings plotting something to harm the Sea Dragon King, but honestly, I don't think we can do it on our own... .

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because I don’t have the strength… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: No. It's me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are they also Agashura...? Can I do it? Maybe I can find out something?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me help you.
(Gatia Su slightly smiles.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You look like Miss Iris. A pure heart for others... .

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: What a beautiful smile.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Please follow me. I will go to where the fire shaman is.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Of course not. I go wherever Gatia goes.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Ah, half. It's a place you can't enter. A place only accessible to shamans and people with special powers... . Please wait outside.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Oh, really? Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are these two people… Hehe, shall we go to the place where the fire shaman is first?)

steps.name: Cthuga's shaman
steps.objective: Defeat [Koa] at the “Heart of Kthuga” in “Kthuga Ruins” and talk to [Gatia Su].

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Although I was embarrassed by the sudden crowd... .

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: After all, you are not an ordinary person. I can't believe I'm having such a hard time... .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: The sea dragon king's shaman... , Now, I can't believe I borrowed someone else's power to come this far. You are wicked.

lines.speaker: 코아
