lines.text: Ugh, disintegration. If I did just a little more, I could have taken down the Sea Dragon King... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it. Why are you doing this here?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: What are you? A guy who has nothing to do with anything... . Oh, you… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: What were you planning to do with the flame shaman, the Sea Dragon King?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Why are you asking me that? My children will be safe only if we defeat that evil sea demon.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Everyone knows that they are planning to destroy all of Cthuga by causing the Sea Dragon King to go berserk.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Now, just a moment. Who said that? Someone is making the Sea Dragon King go berserk... .

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Gatia, the water shaman, is that you too?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: It seems like you are completely misunderstanding. Please speak.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Isn't it you?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Do you think a shrine maiden could do such an unholy thing, taking advantage of the beings she serves? Koa, the shaman of fire. What did you hear?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Is it not your fault that the Sea Dragon King's unstable state began a few years ago?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I swear on the name of the Sea Dragon King and all gods.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You must have heard that story from Choen, right? What did you see and believe in Choen?

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Well, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: You, Agashura, clearly did not trust each other.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: [Crawling Chaos] can't be like that. Me, a living flame... . Ah, maybe I… . And Choen… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Koa, you were taken advantage of. Because she must be the culprit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What? What happened?)

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: I am Agashura, so is Choen... .

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Done. Water shaman. What do you want?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Nothing in particular. I just want to avoid unnecessary fights... . As a fire shaman, you would know.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Think about whether the Sea Dragon King has ever harmed life carelessly.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: Okay. Leave this time.

lines.speaker: 코아
lines.text: However, if you offend me in the slightest, I will not let you go. Because I will cover this place and all of Gyendia with my fire!
(When Koa turns his back, a hot flame blooms around him. The flame soon engulfs Koa and disappears everywhere.)

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Fortunately, I think they understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does this mean that the person named Choen Palm is Agashura? And he incited the fire shaman Koa... . Why is that?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I don't know exactly... . However, there is no doubt that they are planning something.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: The good news is that Koa, the fire shaman, did not show her true self as Agashura.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: If the Kukuri tribe that follows you suffers damage, a fierce battle like before will be inevitable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Choen Palm seems to be a bit different.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Considering that they tried to deceive their own people and neutralize the Sea Dragon King... .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I don't know for sure, but you might get the answer when you look for Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean... .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Since we have nothing to do here, shall we go out? Half of you will be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

steps.name: To Orca Beach
steps.objective: Continue talking with [Gatia Su] and [Ban Ki-woo] in front of the entrance to “Heart of Kthuga.”

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Uh, is it all over?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes, to some extent… .
(Gatia Su briefly explains to the class that the situation has been resolved.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Good job, %s… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I? Then I have to go back and inform Ambassador Seonseong.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: There's no need for that. I will go to Master Seonseong, so you can go the way you originally wanted to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Let's do that. You don't have to go through the hassle of going back.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Since you helped me out, I'll grant you a visit to Atlantis.
(Blue light appears from Gatia's fingertips, surrounds %s's body and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: When you go to Atlantis, go to Mayor Anastasia. If you say I sent you here, I will give you some convenience.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. But which side is Atlantis?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: There's a submersible at Orca Beach, so take it. Anastasia Market is located near the building immediately visible after getting off at Atlantis. and… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I hope you can meet Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I will definitely do that. Meeting Iris is the reason I travel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now let’s go to Orca Beach….)
(Ban Ki-woo and Gatia Su, who were seeing off %s from behind, make eye contact.)

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Gatia.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Yes, half.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: But %s, can he find Iris? They all came back, but only Iris didn't come back, and no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't find it... .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I don't know that, but I have a feeling there might be Iris at the end.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: Where are you going now?

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Me? I am… . Well, like before, I'm going to go to a place where I can make some money.

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I am now going to the Sea Dragon King's residence. so… .

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: If you think of it often, you can make fun of it.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Huh… . really?

lines.speaker: 가티아 수
lines.text: I will go now. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 반 기우
lines.text: Yay!!

steps.name: ancient garden genadia
steps.objective:
1. Go near the suspicious stone tower at “Orca Beach”.  
2. Find and talk to “Sister Maris” and “Berkut” in “Genadia Ground Garden.” 
3. Defeat [Fleeing Hyunmoo] somewhere in the "Submerged Garden" and obtain <Holy Fragment>. Then go to [Sister Maris].

lines.text: (On the other side of the beautiful beach, there are strange things stretching high into the sky, giving it a majestic feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s a beautiful beach… . What is there? Is it like a ruin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never heard of something like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beautiful… .
(%s, who had been looking at the ruins across the sea for a while, heard a voice in his ears.)
Finally…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do you hear it? Is that a stone pagoda?
(The shining stone pagoda built on a small hill on the beach is causing vibrations.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The stone pagoda is leading me.)
This day has come... .
(A girl's appearance appears blurred and disappears repeatedly. She seems to be saying something, but I can't hear her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking to me?
(The girl nods and looks at the ruins across the sea. After a while, the girl disappears and is no longer seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go to Atlantis... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m worried about the girl who just came out….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what should I do to get to those ruins?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stone pagoda?
(The stone pagoda is humming and vibrating again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think they're asking me to put my hand on it... .
(To move inside Zenadia, use the move menu from the stone pagoda.)
(The ruins are filled with a mysterious feeling, but it feels very complicated due to all the monsters and unorganized paths.)
(You can see two people talking in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to ask people who know this place well.

lines.speaker: 어떤 엔지니어
lines.text: It's difficult to handle multiple monsters with my own strength.

lines.speaker: 어떤 시스터
lines.text: No, Berkut. Thanks, it helped me a lot.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Then I'll take a break and then continue. If it doesn't work out, I'll gather people from the Steel City next time. Sister Maris.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Thank you. Hey, was that person, Mr. Berkut, calling you?

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I didn't call anyone, who?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: That person over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello… ? I'm sorry for what I said.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I thought Adventurer would come, but how did it come? And who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm %s… , I'm on a journey to find Iris. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Berkut and Sister Maris how you came to this point from the beginning of your journey to find Iris.)

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Isn’t it amazing? I think you can think of the stone pagoda as a kind of transmission device. Looking for Iris? , Nice to meet you. My introduction was late.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I am an engineer from the steel city... . Well, Berkutne, who people call Meister. The person here is Sister Maris. Say hello.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where is this place?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: This is the ancient garden ‘Genadia’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, are they ancient ruins?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Let me explain. Sister needs a little rest... . Zenadia is an ancient ruin. And not long ago, it appeared like this in front of Orca Beach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that possible?

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I didn't believe it at first either. What a fuss my teacher Icarus made when he discovered it while walking on the beach.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: They said they were going to explore this place, but I stopped hearing from them, so I came here and found that there are indeed ancient ruins.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: When I came to find out how to enter, I found that the sisters were wrestling with the machines that the teacher had made.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I don't know what they made, but I wonder where they disappeared to, leaving behind a bunch of uncontrollable machines. Because he is an irresponsible person. Phew.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Thanks to you, I am having a hard time. What are you doing in a sacred place? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Ah, I think Sister has something she wants to say... .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: It was %s, right? They say they're looking for someone named Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Somehow I feel like I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Iris?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: No. This is about our master, Ceres.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Sister Maris, I'm sorry, but could you wait a moment?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: If Berkut says so, I’m willing… .

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: %s… Did you say that? First of all, I hope we can deal with the obstacles in front of us together. Can you help me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will help you.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: (As expected, this person….)

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: I think my skills are good. I finished it easier than I thought.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Here's something to drink.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then, please tell me what you wanted to say.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Don't be surprised.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Except for Berkut, the priests and sisters here are Pluton Dragons who serve Ceres, the owner and goddess of this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As soon as I heard the story, I squirted out the water in my mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, sorry. Pluton Dragon? But, you look like a human... .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Pluton Dragon is a dragon created by the will of Ceres.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: The time has come for a decisive battle with the Demon Lord Beast... . The moment Ceres is defeated and returns to the realm of chaos... .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Our space and time have stopped. To be exact, it has hardened. So we spent eons trapped in the space of oblivion.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Occasionally, someone would talk to me, but I don't know who it was.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… . Then, Sister… .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: My age is older than you think... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, that's not it. I was wondering if you knew why I came back.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I'm not sure about that. When I returned to the land of Gendia, I realized that a lot of time had passed.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I wondered if Ceres had returned, but that wasn't the case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Still, there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: So I'm looking. We need to prepare for when Ceres comes later in a way that suits the current times.

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Now, now. Let's do our best.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Adventurer… . Are you from the Der tribe?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm just an ordinary person. I know the Der people... .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: A long time ago, Adventurer from Veloras used to come a lot because they loved Zenadia. And the Der people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is Veloras the name of Belos long ago?)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: So what are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I’m here, I want to look around some more.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: It's a bigger place than you think, so you might get lost, but take your time and look around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can help you with?

lines.speaker: 베르쿠트
lines.text: Should I say he's kind or broad? I'll have to find out what else Master left behind. Good luck then.
(Berkut disappears somewhere with familiar steps.)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Well, Adventurer, I would like to express my respect for the courage and heart that brought you here, and ask for a little help.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: As Zenadia reappears, there is an unholy [monster] seeking its power.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: We don't know where it is now, so we are looking for it. If you see it, I want you to take it down just like you did before.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: And I want you to bring me the [Holy Fragment] from that being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Then I will come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .
(As soon as Sister Maris closes her eyes, the world is filled with bright light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, it’s dazzling… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like it warms my heart... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .
(A tree shining with a sacred feeling is swaying in the wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… .
(The image of a girl comes to mind vaguely. She looks like she has something to say.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Story… Is this something you want to do? is it so. Please speak.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Finally… . The day has come.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I've waited for you for a long time.
(The girl's blurry appearance becomes increasingly clear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like it's in front... . But what does that mean? Waiting for a long time... .
(The girl smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Was it hard to get here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel a certain emotion in your smile…. This, this…. Similar to when I heard the name Iris….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been very lonely during this time?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Ah… .
(Tears form around the girl's eyes and soon fall.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: … Did you know? Who am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… . I felt comfortable, like I just knew someone. When I heard that I had waited a long time, I suddenly had a feeling... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was loneliness. I wonder if it would have been lonely... .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Yeah... . Indeed, this is the child that Iris brought in by opening the path to his dreams... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Iris?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Iris is… . No, the Der people are something I created.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: This land that I cherish with love, and the children born on it from the seeds of light containing my soul, I can never see them again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, then you… .

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Iris… . That little child is still living energetically and doing his best.
(The girl wipes away her tears and smiles.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Iris, my precious child Iris… . The reason that child is sick now is because of me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, don't think like that. Iris is… . Iris will soon stand up and laugh. I'll meet you and check.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: What I'm talking about now is Zenadia's remnant. Now that I met you, it will disappear. Before that, I have something to give you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess, Goddess Ceres… .

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Yes, my name is Ceres.

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: When the first starlight fell on Orca Beach, the seeds of life and song were sown.

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: My fleeting and weak existence. Even though it disappears as a fragment of this era... .

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Just as I left the Der people to the world, I leave all the power that remains here to this young Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Remember the life of Giendia. Here, Ceres, the lord of the moon, flowers, and plants, blessed the path ahead of Adventurer... .
(Ceres extends her hand toward Adventurer. Light flows from the Tree of Light and surrounds Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ceres… .

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Please take care of Iris… .

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: The child should be happy... .
(The remnants of Ceres are becoming increasingly blurred. It looks like it will disappear at any moment.)

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: See you again... .

lines.speaker: 세레스
lines.text: Until the time when we all become one... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ceres… , Ceres!!
(Ceres is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , Where on earth is Iris…? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ceres… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meeting Ceres was definitely not a coincidence, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will find Iris and convey Ceres’ message… .
(The tree, shining with a sacred feeling, sways in the wind again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels warm. Comfortable… .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Are you okay? I was surprised that you lost your mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, here… . Sister, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I'm glad you say it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me, Sister… .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I will briefly explain what happened when I saw Ceres’ remnant.)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I had a guess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that Sister is looking for traces of Ceres... . But how did you know to send me there?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: That's not it. It was just Ceres leading the way. Maybe he met and followed Ceres, not me.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: If the person Iris that Adventurer is looking for is the only descendant of the Der tribe... . All of this is a fate given by Ceres... .

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: It must be because Ceres trusts Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: I feel Ceres’ blessing. Thank you, Adventurer… . It's been a long time since I felt this way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I?

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: As we continue to rebuild this place, we will spread Ceres' message and think of ways to help Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I will go.

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Yes, I hope that your journey will be filled with Ceres’ blessings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I told you that if you want to go to Atlantis... you have to take the submersible at Orca Beach, right?)

lines.speaker: 시스터 마리스
lines.text: Ceres… . The world Ceres loved is still truly beautiful. but… .
